findings.evidence: No `GeometricallyIrreducible → GeometricallyConnected` exists in `./mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Geometrically/*` (grep); the proof re-derives it from `GeometricallyIrreducible.geometrically_irreducibleSpace` and the `IrreducibleSpace → ConnectedSpace` instance.
findings.fix: Factor it into a named lemma, e.g. `GeometricallyConnected.of_geometricallyIrreducible` (an `instance` or lemma), and have the field call it; consider upstreaming.
findings.issue: The `geometricallyConnected` field of `ofGeometricallyIntegral` inlines a six-line derivation of the genuinely reusable, mathematically meaningful fact `GeometricallyIrreducible f → GeometricallyConnected f` (via `geometrically_eq_universally`/`universally_mono`), hiding it inside a constructor field where nothing else can use it.

findings.evidence: `smooth_of_grpObj [GeometricallyReduced f] : Smooth f` at Smooth.lean:64 with `variable ... [GrpObj (Over.mk f)]` at Smooth.lean:31; the `haveI` closes the wrapper mismatch by defeq only.
findings.fix: Add a one-line comment noting Mathlib states `smooth_of_grpObj` with `GrpObj (Over.mk f)` and that `Over.mk G.hom` is defeq to `G`, or route through an explicit rewrite/lemma if one exists.
findings.issue: `haveI : GrpObj (Over.mk G.hom) := inferInstanceAs (GrpObj G)` in the `smooth` field silently relies on the defeq `Over.mk G.hom ≡ G` to bridge `GrpObj G` to the `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]` hypothesis of `smooth_of_grpObj`, with no comment explaining why the cast is needed.

summary: The base API and base-change proofs are robust, but ofGeometricallyIntegral buries a reusable fact and relies on an undocumented wrapper defeq.
